away.summary: The Wild (16-3-4) are riding strong form and remain the only NHL team without a regulation loss at home this season. They face key absences on defense (Maatta) and in goal (Gustavsson), with Wallstedt projected to start and Pickard as backup. Nico Sturm returns to the lineup in place of Yakov Trenin, who is away for personal reasons.

home.summary: The Flames (10-11-1) will dress the same lineup they used in a 5-2 win at San Jose on Tuesday. Jonathan Huberdeau is on an injury conditioning loan with the AHL Wranglers after hip resurfacing surgery and is not expected back for this game. Dustin Wolf is projected to start in net with Devin Cooley as backup.
